item.dc:creator: traveltrex
item.content:encoded:
Hi there,

we currently have a 3-node full-meshed SDN using OpenFabric for our ceph backend (used on separate interfaces and networks). Ceph backend uses 25gbit/s FC (we have 2x 2 Port Cards). We want to increase our cluster by 3 nodes but dissolving the SDN in the process, as the setup using a switch with this many nodes is much simpler and less cost-intensive.

What would be the best way to switch away from SDN without downtime?

Thanks in advance!

Patrick

item.title: Feature Suggestion: Display "VLAN Raw Device" in Network Interface Overview
item.author: invalid@example.com (m0z)
item.dc:creator: m0z
item.content:encoded:
Hello,

It would be useful to display the "VLAN raw device" directly in the Proxmox network overview.

Currently, bridge interfaces show their ports/slaves, but for VLAN interfaces the parent interface is only visible when opening the configuration. Displaying the raw device in the interface list would improve visibility and simplify troubleshooting, especially on hosts with many VLANs.

Thanks.
